candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Werkstudent position in data entry and data quality. Careful, accurate work with data is something I have done every day in my previous roles, and I would like to apply it in an international banking environment alongside my M.Sc. studies.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau. Before moving to Germany I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data & analytics at TallyMarks Consulting, where the accuracy of business data was central to my work.

achievements.impact: I performed data validation and data reconciliation to keep company reporting accurate across HR, finance, supply chain and procurement
I handled daily support tickets and user queries for around 30 dashboards, resolving issues in a structured and reliable way
I documented data sources, calculations and results for every dashboard I built

letter.problems_section: In your team I would take care of entering, updating and correcting data exactly according to your guidelines, run quality and completeness checks conscientiously, and treat all information confidentially. I work confidently in Excel and enjoy structured, recurring tasks where accuracy matters.
letter.closing: I am available immediately for 15 to 20 hours per week and am happy to relocate to Düsseldorf to work on site. I would be glad to discuss how I can support your team.
letter.language_closing: My working language is English (IELTS 8.0); I am currently learning German (A1).
